about: Real runs of session 1’s three tasks, made 2026-11-11 under Python 3.12.16 and 3.15.2 in an empty folder; paths renamed to /Users/ana. Right ones from two Pythons and two prompts, and the incomplete ones a learner stopping early would paste. scripts/test-study.mjs grades every receipt (L-AUTH-11; REBUILD.md R3: the gate checks she did the work, whatever her Python).
